News Application

The news application contains the main functionality of Daily Tea, including models, views, forms, services, permissions, serializers, and REST API functionality.

Views

Views for authentication, articles, newsletters, and publisher management.

news.views.approve_article(request, pk)[source]

Allow editors to approve pending articles.

news.views.article_detail(request, pk)[source]

Display a single approved article.

news.views.article_list(request)[source]

Display approved articles to readers.

news.views.create_article(request)[source]

Allow journalists to create articles.

news.views.create_newsletter(request)[source]

Allow journalists and editors to create newsletters.

news.views.create_publisher(request)[source]

Allow editors to create a publisher and assign staff.

news.views.delete_article(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists to delete their own articles.

news.views.delete_newsletter(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists and editors to delete newsletters.

news.views.edit_article(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists to edit their own articles.

news.views.edit_newsletter(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists and editors to edit newsletters.

news.views.editor_dashboard(request)[source]

Display articles waiting for editorial approval.

news.views.editor_delete_article(request, pk)[source]

Allow editors to delete any article.

news.views.editor_edit_article(request, pk)[source]

Allow editors to edit any article.

news.views.home(request)[source]

Display the Daily Tea home page.

news.views.login_view(request)[source]

Authenticate an existing Daily Tea user.

news.views.logout_view(request)[source]

Log the current user out.

news.views.manage_publisher(request, pk)[source]

Allow editors to update a publisher and its assigned staff.

news.views.my_articles(request)[source]

Display the journalist’s articles and dashboard statistics.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, pk)[source]

Display a single newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]

Display published newsletters.

news.views.publish_independent_article(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists to publish their own independent articles.

news.views.publisher_list(request)[source]

Display all publishers to editors.

news.views.register(request)[source]

Register a new Reader or Journalist.

news.views.review_article(request, pk)[source]

Allow an editor to review a pending article.

news.views.subscriptions(request)[source]

Allow readers to manage publisher and journalist subscriptions.
